snippet.title: Star Wars: Hunters  – Season 4 - Survival Instinct Launch – Nintendo Switch
snippet.description:
Unleash your inner assassin with Nox, the new Damage Hunter in Star Wars: Hunters Season 4, now available on Nintendo Switch: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/star-wars-hunters-switch/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=P1065-01&utm_id=P1065-01  

The former Night Wind assassin hails from a remote village on Iridonia, and has joined the Arena to use the spotlight to generate leads about her long lost sister. This Zabrak Archer is deadly from range thanks to her Composite Bow, making her ready to fight on an Endor-inspired battlefield where the forest is reclaiming the planet. 

#StarWarsHunters #NintendoSwitch
